test.yml/test-summary.reason: Reports current run test counts after the test producers settle without grading required results.

test.yml/mutation-refine.reason: Writes the measured mutation plan the shards run; its result reaches Gate Required through the mutation job, which fails when refinement or any shard does not succeed.

test.yml/mutation-shard.reason: Grades one share of the changed line mutants; the mutation job merges every shard report, grades split units and fails when any shard does not succeed.

equivalence.yml/ledger-equivalence.reason: Replays ledger storage and pages on every pull request that touches the ledger package, its tests or this workflow; the equivalence gate task wires it into the gate.

gate-protected.yml/grade.reason: Grades the head's Gate Required wiring from the base branch on pull_request_target and reports its verdict as the Gate Required status, so the aggregator it guards cannot need it.
